headline: TRITN spikes +50.00% intraday, driving the construction sector rally.
market_take: Construction and property stocks led the market with TRITN up +50.00% and KC jumping +50.00% despite low volume. Agribusiness PPPM posted a solid +13.04% gain on strong volume, while several food names such as XBIO (+12.50%) and MADAME (+9.09%) also rallied. Conversely, property peers EVER and PF fell sharply (-25.00% and -20.00% respectively), and a cluster of price‑gap alerts (e.g., CHOTI, QHOP, TPRIME) signal heightened volatility.

sector_notes.note: TRITN surged +50.00% intraday and +50.0% over five days, while TPOLY added +10.00% and SQ rose +5.56%.
KC rose +50.00% on minimal volume; EVER dropped -25.00% and PF fell -20.00% on price‑gap alerts. KUN and SAMCO released Q2 earnings, and SIRI and ORI disclosed large disposals.
XBIO gained +12.50% intraday; MADAME (+9.09%) and CFRESH (+8.20%) also advanced. CHOTI and F&D showed -100.00% open gaps, while TWPC and CH recorded significant volume spikes.
PPPM jumped +13.04% with an 8.4σ volume spike and an intraday rise of +18.18%.
M-PAT surged +8.28% on a 37.5σ volume spike; SSPF opened +5.66% and QHOP, TPRIME, M‑STOR each posted -100.00% price gaps.
STECH rose +5.22% and GEL displayed a -25.00% gap, a +33.33% intraday move, and a 6.5σ volume spike; DCC reported Q2 earnings.
